stock.description: WuXi XDC Cayman Inc. operates as an investment holding company and a global contract research, development, and manufacturing organization (CRDMO), with operations spanning China, North America, Europe, and other international regions. The company's expertise covers the entire lifecycle, from discovery and research to development and manufacturing, of biopharmaceutical products. Specifically, it focuses on antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs), various bioconjugates, monoclonal antibody intermediates, and the crucial payload-linkers integral to bioconjugate synthesis. Founded in 2013 and headquartered in Wuxi, China, WuXi XDC Cayman Inc. is a subsidiary of WuXi Biologics (Cayman) Inc.
